title: Photographer at Yankees-Angels struck in head by foul ball, carted off field
content:
ANAHEIM, Calif. — The New York Yankees and Los Angeles Angels were delayed for about 10 minutes Wednesday evening after a foul ball struck a photographer in the head.

Yankees first baseman Ben Rice’s 79.5 mph line drive went down the first-base line into the camera well. Yankees players gathered on the far end of the dugout to check on the man, and team trainer Tim Lentych called for additional help from Angels trainers and paramedics.

Rice, with helmet and bat in hand, stood next to the camera well, watching as he was treated. The photographer eventually walked to the medical cart on his own power, shaking Rice’s hand as he was fitted with a neck brace.

The man’s exact condition was unclear. At the time, the Yankees led the Angels 1-0 in the top of the sixth inning.

This story will be updated.
